blocks.title: Phishing
blocks.text: Phishing aisa dhoka hai jis mein koi bharosemand idara ban kar aap se zaati maloomat nikalwata hai.
Aisi email jo aap ke bank ki lagti hai link daba kar account ki tafseel dalne ko kehti hai; aisa karne se aap ka paisa khatre mein ho sakta hai kyunke email jaali hai.

blocks.prompt: Do alamaat bataiye ke email phishing ho sakti hai.
blocks.explanation: Yeh fori taur par password ya account ki tafseel maangti hai, aur is ka link ya bhejne wale ka address asal idare se mel nahi khata.

items: Phishing: bharosemand idare ban kar tafseel churane wale jaali paigham.
